ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope and extent of child care fraud in Minnesota, and examine the efforts being made to prevent and detect it
questions: What is the total amount of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How many providers have been disenrolled for fraudulent activity?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on a critical issue affecting Minnesota taxpayers
